comment: MA-8-10: a stair from a flag. Read by changesets-logic.test.mjs (the bridge validates `good` and refuses each of `refusals` in the exact words) and by tools/promote-check Ma8Stairs.cs (StairPlanner's body for `plan` equals `good`, and Risers() answers `risers`). example.test names only.

good.name: Stair · L00 → L01 · from Stair picked on L00

elements.reason: 16 risers of 187.5 mm (type maximum 190 mm), going 250 mm (type minimum), width 1200 mm (guideline guideline@2 default) — one straight run between L00 and L01; landings, turns, winders and railings are a person's

refusals.name: a place key a stair does not take
refusals.message: a stair takes no place.Boundary — it is one straight run between two levels

refusals.name: a base elevation is the levels'
refusals.message: a stair takes no place.BaseElevation — it is one straight run between two levels

refusals.name: no bottom level
refusals.message: a stair needs place.LevelName (the level it rises from) and place.TopLevel (the level its top reaches) — Sentinel never picks its levels

refusals.name: no top level
refusals.message: a stair needs place.LevelName (the level it rises from) and place.TopLevel (the level its top reaches) — Sentinel never picks its levels

refusals.name: the top is its own level
refusals.message: place.TopLevel is the stair's own level — name the level its top reaches

refusals.name: no type
refusals.message: a stair needs place.FamilyName and place.TypeName — the office's stair type (the guideline's Stairs rule); Sentinel never takes the model's first type

refusals.name: no family
refusals.message: a stair needs place.FamilyName and place.TypeName — the office's stair type (the guideline's Stairs rule); Sentinel never takes the model's first type

refusals.name: no run
refusals.message: a stair needs place.LocationCurve with finite [x,y,z] start and end — the run's centre line, first riser to last

refusals.name: a run with a mid point
refusals.message: a stair is one straight run — place.LocationCurve takes no mid

refusals.name: a run that climbs
refusals.message: a stair's LocationCurve is level — start and end z within 1 mm (the rise is the two levels')

refusals.name: one riser
refusals.message: a stair needs place.Risers, a whole number from 2 to 60

refusals.name: 61 risers
refusals.message: a stair needs place.Risers, a whole number from 2 to 60

refusals.name: a fractional riser count
refusals.message: a stair needs place.Risers, a whole number from 2 to 60

refusals.name: a going under 100 mm
refusals.message: a stair needs place.Going, a number of mm from 100 to 1000

refusals.name: a width under 300 mm
refusals.message: a stair needs place.Width, its run width, a number of mm from 300 to 5000

refusals.name: a width over 5000 mm
refusals.message: a stair needs place.Width, its run width, a number of mm from 300 to 5000

refusals.name: N x going instead of (N - 1) x going
refusals.message: the run is 4000 mm; 16 risers at 250 mm going need 3750 mm ((risers − 1) × going)
